messages:
Ava Martinez: Quick sync  partner (StratoCloud) sent a proposed private-offer matrix that ties discounts to SLA tiers + committed spend. Ops/finance/legal need to check enforceability.
Theo Grant: upload looks like this: 3 tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold). higher SLA = higher discount + migration credit. they want this published as a private offer in the marketplace.
Sam (Legal): high-level red flags: SLA-linked discounts must have precise measurement windows, remediation steps, and cap on credit liability. avoid open-ended "penalties" language.
Rosa (Finance): also need to know how credits are accounted for. prefer credits applied as contra-revenue in the invoice month theyre issued. need a global exposure cap per partner.
Liam (PM): product question  can runtime report SLA metrics to marketplace for automatic credit triggers? we have 99.5/99.9 sliding windows, but marketplace expects explicit flags.
DevOps-Bot: Created task #8801: instrument SLA metrics export endpoint. ETA 72h.
Theo Grant: partner wants the following table in the private offer metadata:
```
Tier | Committed QPS | Discount | SLA | Migration credit
Bronze | 0-100k | 10% | 99.5% monthly | $5k
Silver | 100k-500k | 18% | 99.8% monthly | $12k
Gold | 500k+ | 25% | 99.95% monthly | $30k
```
They also want 2-year step-downs on discounts.
Sam (Legal): revisions we need:
- Define SLA measurement method & timezone
- Remediation steps (credits only) and cap (e.g., credits <= 15% of monthly invoice)
- Renewal step-down schedule spelled out (auto-step unless notice)
- Appendix: audit rights & data export format
- Embargo clause for public pricing until listing
Rosa (Finance): propose credit cap = min($100k, 12% of committed ARR) AND per-incident cap = 15% of monthly invoice. credits treated as contra-revenue. we also need to subtract marketplace fee (e.g., 7%) when modeling net ARR.
Theo Grant: ops constraints: automated credit requires marketplace webhook + our SLA exporter. if webhook fails, fallback to manual audit. need 30d reconciliation window.
Liam (PM): SI integration note  hardware partners want the marketplace SKU to show "endorsed by" flags in regions. that affects co-announcement timing. are we okay exposing partner logos pre-list?
Sam (Legal): only under NDA and with partner-signed co-announcement plan. marketing embargo rules apply.
DevOps-Bot: Task #8801 updated: SLA exporter + webhook proof-of-concept. ETA 48h for PoC.
Rosa (Finance): decision inputs needed from product: confirm measurement windows and if credits are applied automatically or via claim. finance prefers automatic but needs audit logs.
Ava Martinez: propose decision set:
- Allow SLA-tiered discount matrix in private offers if legal & finance clauses included
- Credit caps: per-incident 15% monthly invoice, global cap min($100k, 12% committed ARR)
- Auto-apply credits if SLA exporter + marketplace webhook confirm breach; else manual claim with 30d reconciliation
- Include 2-year discount step-down in T&Cs (explicit table)
- SI/hardware partner logos only in co-announcement collateral under NDA until listing
Sam (Legal): I'll draft the T&Cs and appendix with those items. will note that credits are remedial only and do not create penalties.
Rosa (Finance): I'll run a quick exposure model and share recommended cap by EOD.
Theo Grant: I'll coordinate eng-ops to fast-track SLA exporter and webhook POC.
Liam (PM): I'll update the partner brief with the co-announcement routing and embargo rules.
Ava Martinez: great  action items assigned. reconvene tomorrow 10am PT to sign off. :white_check_mark:
